subject: E-Commerce
title: Visual Search Shopping
description: A short lesson to help you apply Visual Search Shopping.

hook.text: Snap a photo of shoes on the street & find them online instantly. Visual search turns every image into a shopping link.

buildup.text: Google Lens, Pinterest Lens, and Amazon visual search identify products from photos and match them to listings.

discovery.text: Pinterest Lens processes 600 million visual searches per month. Users photograph items and find where to buy them.

twist.text: Visual search often returns cheaper look-alikes instead of the exact item. It accelerates the knockoff economy.

climax.text: Visual search makes the entire physical world shoppable. See anything, buy it instantly—or a cheaper version of it.

punchline.text: 600M visual searches monthly. Point your camera, find the product—or its $10.

quiz.question: What does visual search in e-commerce allow you to do?
options: Photograph any item and instantly find where to buy it or similar products online
